personal.title: Senior PHP/Laravel Developer
personal.about_me: Senior PHP/Laravel Developer with over 6 years of experience delivering scalable web applications. Skilled in Laravel, Vue.js, GraphQL, and Node.js with strong expertise in REST APIs, real-time applications, and database optimization. Proven track record of building enterprise-grade solutions, mentoring junior developers, and thriving in remote Agile teams. Experienced in using AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) to speed up delivery, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and streamline design-to-code workflows.
